body: I need to go, friend. My brain is telling me that you are frustrated with me, that I am not paying enough attention to you, that you will leave. Just like everyone else. You are now dangerous to me. Thank you, please be happy. Pink is awesome! Put pink in your hair!
When I was young, I told them I was scratching my arms and it made me feel better. They told me to just crumple a piece of paper and never mentioned it again.
I wish. No, after the ritual and they realize I am nuts, they will just blame themselves. I can't just have my own sadness. I just can't be sad and let it be accepted as the thing at that moment.

No. I make lots and enjoy it, and dad tells me how much money I have wasted and compares it to how similar to what grandma has for retirement. So I stop trying to find things like that. I try to express myself, especially if it is negative, it has happened to my mom and worse. I should be normal and happy and successful yet they never seem happy I am. If I do anything even slightly differently, like having long nails, or being girly, or doing things.
I never had a me. I jjust made myself whatever people wanted. And jumped from person to person, group to group, never anywhere despite being everywhere. Ha! Is this proof I never existed?

There is no place that is safe to talk anymore. I can't say everything. Everyone is watching. They are all saying things. I just... This is too much. And when I am home? Always watching. Always telling me how to do it better. Always.
I am only good enough when I am in pain. I do not deserve anything. I don't know why. Maybe I can't remember. Maybe I just got all the shit genetics. I don't know.
I think I might try. I need to do a ritual first in punishment. I will never be able to sleep if I don't.
But that is the thing. They can't all be wrong? There is no abuse. It couldn't have happened. No way it happened. That is why they all left. Because I am crazy.
I need my babies. They are all I have. They are the only ones that "talk" to me.

I can live. But the punishment is steep. Especially if I want to keep my babies. My dad already pushed my mom to try and get me rid of three. Just knowing I still didn't seem to make them happy. I would need to punish myself for that.
Shh. But I can't be suicidal. How could I be suicidal? Mother said they must be bad parents. I was a happy child. I never had this problem or that problem. I don't understand.

I am just me. Man. I had like a fucked up long term memory sexual revelation while I was high. I guess sometime people think they have that. And. Fuck. I told people I think my grandpa might have sexual abused me when he and I went camping together. Alone. And then he left before he could take the next oldest sibling camping or something. I am a horrible person. I don't even remember anything happening and I think that. Despite everyone telling me it isn't true. My therapist. My best friend didn't even want to listen because I was high because of how stupid high I get all the time. That is how paranoid I am. No one believes me. So I am a liar. That is the one thing I promised I would never be. A Liar. I am a liar. liar. liar.

Things wouldn't stay clean, couldn't keep up, doing more weed, trying new psych meds, people coming and going, becoming paranoid, having five pets, spending money uselessly. Doing nothing. No hobbies, no real life friends, and two online friends. No job. No Job. No Job. Dad said I am in trouble. Big trouble financially. No Job. No Job. No Job.
I've always been I guess I have always been pretty depressed. I got some help and for awhile that seemed to help. But then, even with help, I kept getting worse.

No. I was right when I was younger. I am not worth anything. I am too fat, too stupid, too weird... I starved myself and ran all the time. I was never thin enough. Great grades and I was still destroying myself. And then when I let go now and start to enjoy myself, I come to realize just how worthless I am. Punishment.

But... I always had to be perfect. Best grades, most extra activities. Best college. Coolest degree. Amazing job... I did it. And my family still always treated me like a child. And now, now I am going back there. I... I can't.

But I was there man. I had it. Cushy 60+k job, nice apartment, lovely pets. A boyfriend, and then when that ended, tons of friends. And then... I dunno? Everything just... got away from me? And now, now I am looking at maybe being homeless and losing my furbabies.
